title: glab api projects/${project}/merge_requests/${n}/discussions?per_page=100 --paginate
description: A merge request's discussions, ${project} the project's path URL-encoded and ${n} its iid, whose notes kit counts as unresolved review threads when they are resolvable and not resolved, in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh` (forge/gitlab:open-prs, with `modules/jq/forge.jq` forge::gitlab_pr); --paginate prints one such array per page. The types are APIEntitiesDiscussion and APIEntitiesNote of GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/merge_requests/{noteable_id}/discussions in GitLab's REST OpenAPI, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/master/doc/api/openapi/openapi_v3.yaml, as https://docs.gitlab.com/api/discussions/ describes them.

resolved.description: Whether the note is resolved; given for a resolvable note.
